onboarding.company.description: What your company sells, to whom and how it speaks. Whytide's message drafts build on it.
onboarding.company.documents.draft_hint: Whytide drafts the fields below from the files' text, and from your website's pages when one is saved. You check the draft before it replaces anything.
onboarding.company.documents.hint: PDF, Markdown or text files, {files} at most, {megabytes} MB each. Their text is read in your browser and sent with the Draft; the files themselves are not stored.
onboarding.company.documents.title: Documents
onboarding.company.draft_failed: The draft from your website failed.
onboarding.company.draft_hint: Whytide reads the main pages of your website and drafts the fields below. You check the draft before it replaces anything.
onboarding.company.draft_pending_confirm: A draft is waiting for your review. Draft again and drop it?
onboarding.company.draft_ready: A draft from your website: check it before it replaces anything
onboarding.company.empty: Your Company Knowledge is empty. Enter your website and press Draft from website, or fill in the fields yourself.
onboarding.company.error: Your Company Knowledge could not be loaded
onboarding.company.fetch_failed: Your website could not be read.
onboarding.company.invalid: Check this field: it is too long or has too many items.
onboarding.company.last_changed: Last changed <time>{when}</time> by {kind, select, ai_draft {an AI draft you accepted} other {a person}}.
onboarding.company.pages_read: {count, plural, one {# page read} other {# pages read}}
onboarding.company.replace_edited: Also replace the fields I edited
onboarding.company.review.empty: The draft found nothing to fill in from your website. Discard it, or fill in the fields yourself.
onboarding.company.section.about_hint: What it is, in a line and in a paragraph.
onboarding.company.section.market_hint: The problems your customers have, and who else they could buy from.
onboarding.company.section.offer_hint: Your products and offers, what they do for a customer, and the proof.
onboarding.company.source.hint: {kind, select, ai_draft {This field comes from a draft of your website that you accepted.} other {A person wrote this field, so a new draft leaves it as it is unless you ask to replace it.}}
onboarding.company.stuck: Reading your website has taken more than twenty minutes, so it may be stuck. Press Draft from website to try again.
onboarding.company.title: Company Knowledge
onboarding.errors.ai_failed: The draft did not hold up to the checks, so nothing was changed. Try the Draft again, or fill the fields by hand.
onboarding.errors.company_knowledge_inva: Enter a web address that starts with http:// or https://.
onboarding.errors.company_knowledge_no_d: There is no draft to accept or discard: it was accepted or discarded already.
onboarding.errors.company_knowledge_no_w: Save a website or add documents first, then draft.
onboarding.errors.document_encrypted: It is protected by a password, so it cannot be read.
onboarding.errors.document_name_invalid: Its name cannot be used. Rename the file and add it again.
onboarding.errors.document_name_repeated: A file with this name is in the list already.
onboarding.errors.document_no_text: It has no text to read. A scanned file needs a text layer first.
onboarding.errors.document_type_unsuppor: Only PDF, Markdown and text files can be read.
onboarding.errors.document_unreadable: It could not be read: it may be damaged, or not in UTF-8.
onboarding.errors.documents_too_many: {files} files at most: remove one to add another.
onboarding.errors.draft_agent_not_loaded: Drafting is not available right now. Try again later.
onboarding.errors.draft_empty: The draft found nothing to fill in, so nothing was saved. Fill in the fields yourself, or draft from documents.
onboarding.errors.draft_failed: The draft could not be made. Try again later.
onboarding.errors.egress_blocked_address: Whytide cannot reach this address. Check the website and try again.
onboarding.errors.egress_timeout: The website took too long to answer. Try again later.
onboarding.errors.egress_too_large: The website sent more than Whytide reads at once.
onboarding.errors.fetch_failed: The website did not answer with a page Whytide can read.
onboarding.get_started.body: Enter your company's website. Whytide reads it, saves what it learns as your Company Knowledge, then builds your ICP from it. It takes a few minutes.
onboarding.get_started.icp.failed: Your ICP could not be drafted. Draft it on the ICP screen.
onboarding.get_started.icp.review: A draft of your ICP is waiting for your review on the ICP screen.
onboarding.get_started.icp.set: Your ICP was already set, so Whytide left it as it is.
onboarding.get_started.icp.stuck: Building your ICP has taken more than ten minutes, so it may be stuck. Look at the ICP screen later.
onboarding.get_started.review: A draft of your Company Knowledge is waiting for your review.
onboarding.get_started.stuck: Building has taken more than twenty minutes, so it may be stuck. Try again, or set it up yourself.
onboarding.get_started.title: Set up Whytide from your website
